hypothesis: A pinned, untrained reduced-patch FlyVis network produces finite stimulus-dependent activity and repeats within the same locked CPU environment.
task: Technical model execution on synthetic uniform gray, ON-flash and OFF-flash stimuli; not a biological reference reproduction or market forecast.

upstream.asset_scope: Bundled model specification in the pinned repository; no external trained weights, stimulus datasets or reference archives.

architecture.implementation: Upstream Network defaults except explicit reduced connectome settings
architecture.parameter_budget: Recorded from constructed network; no optimization or training
architecture.boundary_effects: Reduced spatial patch omits connections outside the patch; not the publication-scale network

inputs.preprocessing: Uniform intensity across all photoreceptor positions; no external observations or missing data

controls: Constant gray condition on the same network
Repeat with identical seed and input in the same environment

metrics.non_input_flash_max_absolute_difference_: Must exceed 0.0000001 for at least one flash condition

criteria.PASS_TECHNICAL_ONLY: All registered metrics pass, shape and provenance checks pass, no checkpoint is loaded, and all resource limits are respected.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Dependency, source, platform, resource or runtime error prevents a valid measurement; preserve errors without changing this registration.
criteria.REJECT_TECHNICAL_HYPOTHESIS: A completed valid run fails at least one registered numerical metric.
criteria.promotion: Never establishes biological validity, market usefulness, calibrated confidence or permission for live execution. Any changed criterion requires a new experiment ID.

known_limitations: Untrained defaults, reduced geometry and synthetic stimuli cannot reproduce the paper's trained-network results.
A response difference can show execution and stimulus propagation only; it does not establish visual interpretation or cognition.
One seed and two repeats test local determinism only, not scientific robustness or cross-platform equivalence.
Code hashes and self-reported receipts do not independently prove truthful execution.
A virtual environment and Python-level loading guards are not an operating-system security sandbox.
